cases.name: seed_db
cases.eval: $pdo=$GLOBALS['db_link']; $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE shop_catalogue_categories (`id` int auto_increment primary key, `alias` varchar(255), `url` varchar(255), `count` int, `level` int, `value` varchar(255), `parent` int, `title_tag` varchar(255), `description_tag` varchar(255), `keywords_tag` varchar(255), `order` int, `published_flag` int)'); $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE shop_catalogue_products (`id` int auto_increment primary key, `caption` varchar(255), `alias` varchar(255), `published_flag` int, `price` decimal(12,2), `time_created` int)'); $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE shop_catalogue_product_categories (`product_id` int, `category_id` int)'); $pdo->exec('CREATE TABLE shop_catalogue_product_images (`product_id` int, `image_url` varchar(512), `sort_order` int)'); $r1=epc_storefront_seed_all($pdo, 'electronics', 'electronicae'); $r2=epc_storefront_seed_all($pdo, 'electronics', 'electronicae'); $cats=(int)$pdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_catalogue_categories')->fetchColumn(); $prods=(int)$pdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_catalogue_products')->fetchColumn(); $links=(int)$pdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_catalogue_product_categories')->fetchColumn(); $imgs=(int)$pdo->query('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_catalogue_product_images')->fetchColumn(); $id1=epc_storefront_seed_upsert_category($pdo, array('alias'=>'elc-smartphones','name'=>'Smartphones & Mobiles','url'=>'smartphones','level'=>1,'order'=>10), 0); $id2=epc_storefront_seed_upsert_category($pdo, array('alias'=>'elc-smartphones','name'=>'Phones','url'=>'phones','level'=>1,'order'=>11), 0); $val=$pdo->query("SELECT `value`,`url`,`order` FROM shop_catalogue_categories WHERE alias='elc-smartphones'")->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC); return array($r1['industry'], $r1['site_key'], $r1['currency'], $r1['region'], $r1['categories'], $r1['products'], $r1['errors'], $r2['categories'], $r2['products'], $cats, $prods, $links, $imgs, $id1, $id2, $id1===$id2, $val);
